verses.text: Ixlajwi chi' ix sch'oxanxi sb'a Jehová t'a winhaj Abraham t'a slak'anil juntzanh te' ji t'a yol yik winhaj Mamre. Chimk'uhalil am wal k'ojanelta winh t'a sti' smantiado.
Haxo ix yilan winh, linhjab' ek' oxwanh winak t'a yichanhb'at winh. Ayik ix yilan heb' chi' winh, ix b'at lemnaj winh schakot heb', ix emk'och nhojnaj winh t'a sat lum t'a yichanh heb'.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: --Ach mamin, tato wach' in tzila', tzin tewi t'ayach to manh b'enhejok tzex ek'i.
Tanhwejek, b'at wala' yik tz'ik'chajkot jab'ok ha ha' yik tze b'ikel eyok, tzeyik'an eyip t'a yich te te' tik.
Yakb'an ayex ek' t'a in tz'ey tik, tzin b'at wik'kot jab'ok tas ol he wa', yik wach' tz'och eyip, ichato chi' ol ex b'atxok, xchi winh t'a heb'. --Ixik an, xchi heb' t'a winh.
Ix ochb'at lemnaj winh t'a yol smantiado. Ix yalan winh t'a ix Sara icha tik: --Lem, ik'kot junok koxtal ixim harina te wach', tza b'oan jantakok pan staji t'a kal tzak'ak', xchi winh t'a ix.
Ix b'at lemnaj winh b'aj ay nok' swakax, ix b'at yik'ankot jun nok' kelem wakax winh te wach', ix yak'an nok' winh t'a jun winh schekab' yik sb'o nok' winh t'a elanhchamel yik schichaj nok'.

Ix yik'ankot mantequilla winh yet' lech yet' nok' chib'ej ix b'ochaj chi', ix yik'anb'at winh t'a yichanh heb' yik swa heb'. Yakb'an wan swa heb' chi', ix och tek'tek' winh t'a stz'ey heb' t'a yich te te' chi'.
Ix sk'anb'an heb' t'a winh icha tik: --¿B'ajtil ayek' ix Sara ix etb'eyum? xchi heb'. --Ayoch ix t'a yol ko mantiado tik, xchi winh t'a heb'.

Ix yalan junok heb' icha tik: --Yab' icha tik junab', swak'anxi a paxyal, hata' ol aljok junok yune' ix etb'eyum tik, winak unin, xchi t'a winh. Yakb'an a ix Sara chi' wan smaklan yab' ix tas syala', ayek' ix t'a sti' smantiado heb' t'a spatik winhaj Abraham chi'.
Ha winhaj Abraham yet' ix Sara chi' te ichamtak animaxo heb'. Ha ix Sara chi' pekatax manhxalaj yechel unin syil ix,

yuj chi' tonhej ix tzewaj ix t'a yol sk'o'ol. Ayik ix yab'an ix yalji jun chi', ix sna'an ix icha tik: ¿Tasto wal ol aj in nib'anoch jun tik, ina te chichim inxo, te ichamxo pax winh wetb'eyum? xchi ix.
Yuj chi' ix yalan Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --¿Tas yuj tonhej stzewaj ix etb'eyum chi'? ¿Tzam sna' ix yujto chichimxo ix maxtzak yal yalji junok yune' ix?
¿Tom ay tas ajaltak t'ayin tze na'a? Yab' icha tik junab', tzin jax junelxo, swak'anxi a paxyal. Hata' ol aljok jun yune' ix Sara chi', winak unin, xchi Jehová.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' ix Sara chi', ix te xiw ix, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Malaj in tzin tzewaji, xchi ix. Haxo ix tak'wi Jehová t'a ix icha tik: --Wojtak to ix ach tzewaji, xchi.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at heb' oxwanh chi' t'a sb'e'al Sodoma. Ix b'at winhaj Abraham yet' heb' yik stak'lankan sb'a heb' yet' winh.
Ix yalan Jehová icha tik: Max yal-laj in k'ub'anel t'a winhaj Abraham tik tas toxo ol in k'ulej.
Ina to a winh ol och smam yichamok jun niwan nación te tek'an ol ajok. Toxo ix wak' in ti' to yuj winh ol scha' in wach'k'olal masanil nación t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Ha in ix in sik'elta winh, yik wach' syalel in cheknab'il winh t'a masanil yuninal yet' heb' kajan yet'ok, yik wach' sk'anab'ajej heb' sb'eyb'alan masanil tas wach' yet' tojolal, yik wach' swak'elk'och jantak in lolonel ix wal t'a winh, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yalan t'a winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Masanil anima ay t'a Sodoma yet' t'a Gomorra, yalxonhej b'aj te chuk yel spekal heb', haxonhej wal chukal sk'ulej heb'.
Ha tikne'ik, tik tzin b'at wila'', tato yel haxonhej chukal chi' sk'ulej heb' icha tz'aj yalchaj chi' t'ayin yik ol wojtakejeli tas yaji, xchi Jehová chi'.
Ay chawanh heb' b'enhej ix b'atkan t'a Sodoma, haxo winhaj Abraham chi' ix lolonkan winh yet' Jehová.
Ix snitzanb'at jab'xo sb'a winh t'a stz'ey Jehová chi', ix sk'anb'an winh icha tik: ¿Tom ol a satel heb' anima malaj smul yet' heb' ay smul?
K'inalok ay 50-ok heb' wach' t'a jun chonhab' chi', ¿tom ol a satel heb'? ¿tom manh ol ak' niwank'olal yuj heb' 50 malaj smul chi'?

Manh ol yal utan icha chi'. Tato tza satel heb' malaj smul yet' heb' ay smul chi', ichato lajan smul heb' smasanil syal chi'. Manh utej icha chi'. Ha ach tik Juez ach t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, ¿tokwal ol a k'ulej junok tas manh tojolok? xchi winh t'ay.
Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh icha tik: --Tato ay 50-ok heb' wach' t'a chonhab' Sodoma chi', yuj heb' swak' niwank'olal masanil heb' kajan t'a jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ak' niwank'olal t'ayin ach Wajalil yuj tas swal tik t'ayach, yujto a in tik, anima innhej.

K'inalok ayxonhej owanhok max tz'akwi 50 anima wach', ¿tom yujxonhej owanh chi', tza satel jun chonhab' chi' smasanil? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová icha tik: --Tato ay 45-ok heb' wach', max in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --K'inalok anhej 40-ok heb' wach', xchi winh. --Yuj heb' 40 chi', manh ol in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi Jehová.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi' icha tik: --Ach Wajalil tzin tewi t'ayach, mokab' kot owal swalan t'ayach. K'inalok anhej 30-ok heb' wach' tz'ilchaj u'uj, xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ha yuj heb' 30 chi', ol wak' niwank'olal jun chonhab' chi', xchi.

Haxo winhaj Abraham chi' ix ochnhej ijan winh yalani: --Mamin Wajalil, tzin tewi wal t'ayach, ¿tas tzutej ta haxonhej 20-ok heb' wach'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wixi Jehová chi' icha tik: --Ha yuj heb' 20 chi', manh ol in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.

Ix yalanxi winhaj Abraham chi': --Ak'wal niwank'olal t'ayin ach Wajalil, mokab' kot owal t'ayin, haxonhej junel tik tzin tewi t'ayach, manhxa tas ol wala': ¿Tas tzutej, k'inalok tato haxonhej lajunhwanhok heb' wach' sb'eyb'al tz'ilchaj u'uj? xchi winh. Ix yalanxi Jehová chi' icha tik: --K'inalok ay lajunhwanhok heb' wach' sb'eyb'al, manh ol in satel-laj jun chonhab' chi', xchi.
Haxo ix lajwi slolon heb' chi', ix b'at Jehová, ix smeltzajkan winhaj Abraham chi' t'a smantiado.
